about_the_game:
With Friends Like These<br>More Options For Big Apple Sewer Samurai: Season 1, Episode 2

Note: You need the Savage Worlds core book and the Big Apple Sewer Samurai Setting Book to Play

Breach a priceless vault filled to the brim with secrets and knowledge. Make a deal with the Moon itself. Learn the mysteries of the Keepers of the Demon Gate. Delve into this first adventure for the Big Apple Sewer Samurai setting like it's saturday morning in the 80s again!

You'll find a lot to improve your Savage World experience within these 80+ pages:

<ul> <li> Rules for Duels, whether it is a samurai showdown or a cooking contest. Usable in any settings.</li>
<li> 15 new Style Edges (for a total of 75 Edges) to give more tools to martial artists of all kind.</li>
<li> 23 characters and multiple locations to give life to your cartoon-inspired setting.</li>
<li> A complete adventure and several Savage Tales.</li>
<li> 2 New Maps with Line of Sight included. </li>
</ul> Everything in this book will expand your own Big Apple Sewer Samurai campaign, or serve as inspiration for any other settings. 
"
